# GuiCodec

> Convert GUI instances to code and back.

- Package: `GuiCodec` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("GuiCodec")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("GuiCodec")` on the client

## `Gaxia.GuiCodec`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/GuiCodec.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local GuiCodec = Gaxia.GuiCodec
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local GuiCodec = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.GuiCodec)
```

### Functions

- `GuiCodec.Make(className: string, props: { [string]: any }?, children: { Instance }?): Instance`
- `GuiCodec.ToCode(root: Instance, opts: { varName: string? }?): string`
  Emit Luau source that rebuilds `root` via a `make(className, props, children)` helper. `opts.varName` names the returned local (default "root").
